notes: finding your way back to your own work. The search box over the chat list used to match the first twenty things you said and nothing else — not one word of what the assistant answered, and nothing at all past the twentieth turn — so a long conversation was findable only by how it opened. It now indexes both sides over the whole length of the chat, and the chats you already have are re-indexed once on this first start. Tool results stay out on purpose: they are most of a long chat's bytes and the least useful thing to match on. A message you sent can be rewritten: hover it, click Edit, and it becomes a field in place — nothing is thrown away until you save, and saving replaces the answer it got and everything after it, so a question that came out wrong no longer has to be deleted and typed again. And two keys that were missing: Ctrl/Cmd+B shows or hides the sidebar, Escape stops a running reply. None of the shortcuts fire any more while a dialog or a permission prompt is waiting for an answer
